card.name: Linking words after "increase" with calcium
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "the", "in" or "of" right after "increase(s)" in calcium or electrolyte interaction text. It also fires on the verb "increase" itself after "may".

modes.label: After increase
modes.description: The word "the" or "in" directly after "increase" before a risk or level term, in calcium-related warnings.
modes.example: Hypercalcemia of any cause, including RAYALDEE [ see Warnings and Precautions ( 5.1 ) ], increases<< the>> risk of digitalis toxicity.

modes.label: The verb increase
modes.description: The verb "increase" after "may" in drug interaction text about calcium or magnesium.
modes.example: high doses of magnesium-containing products may<< increase>> the risk of hypermagnesemia

card.plain: It marks the small word after "increase" in calcium warnings, just before a risk such as digoxin toxicity is named.
